text: The human voice carries identity, emotion, and the rhythm of lived experience.
notes: neutral is the calibrated face style with no emotion/accent residual.
0.28 is the E1-validated emotion scale; 0.56 is a doubled exploratory scale.
0.3 is the A3-selected accent scale; 0.5 is an exploratory extension.
ECAPA similarity is to the same voice's neutral; real AMI between-speaker same-gender median is about 0.115 (see ecapa_reference.json).
No human MOS/CMOS or emotion/accent identification study was run.
